instruction: Candid office photograph, medium full shot. The man (R3) raises his right hand to meet the raised left hand of the smiling woman (R1). On the bottom right, a cropped, blurry arm of a bystander in dark clothing is partially visible. The lighting is bright and even, creating a clean and professional atmosphere.
